caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate, symmetrical altar or altarpiece structure rendered in shades of brown and tan, giving a wood-carved appearance. At the top center is a pointed, ornate gable with a finial, featuring leafy decorative elements and an inset panel illustrating a scene involving two figures. Beneath this is a horizontal row of small, rounded shapes resembling heads or busts in relief, possibly representing saints or apostles. Below this row, there is a horizontal inscription in capital letters. The central section of the structure is dominated by a large recessed area with a depiction of a crucified figure—with arms outstretched and a halo—flanked by two smaller figures on crosses. Ornamental patterns decorate the area around the central figures. On both the left and right sides of the main structure, there are vertical panels; each contains circular haloed portraits in the upper part and narrative scenes involving groups of people in the lower part. Decorative columns and intricate filigree-like patterns frame the entire structure, and there are finials at both upper side corners. The entire design is produced in fine line-work, with intricate detail, portraying the appearance of carved wood and engraved surfaces.
title: Decorah Altar
